title: Paired lookups, one-square u^2 and v^2, canonical fold bound

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins: one fresh 64-bit coin opens the run with probability K/2^64, K = 7204349353426883848, the least integer with (K/2^64) lo_run >= 0.39, lo_run the exact opened-run lower bound of success.md 6.5 (Chen-Stein on cross-node leaf pairs, conditioning on points; drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the carry and weak-operand sites of section 3.4 and the fixup meter's cap are charged failure rows). Its expected total work is at most 2^123.551543532900289 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit), 2^7 + (K/2^64) E_run, with an opened run's work at most 78.1835 per leaf E-averaged over 780 groups of 688296 Y-batches (q1 = 536870880) that stop at the first resolving group, every walk, key path, main-pair K2 verification and defect row charged by history-conditional domination (success.md 6.6); the worst case on every run, 2^190.490444 instructions, is disclosed. Each of 2^72 nodes keeps 1024 permanent points X with 6144 TiB of lookup tables (tblx, charged) and generates each batch's 2^15 points Y = C + [m t + n s]P (m < 8192, n < 4) with one shared inverse per step (ygen, charged); six leaves x(phi^t(X) +- Y) per incidence come from one batched inverse per pair of X's (fwd 71.6260 and bwd 1074.6924 instructions per incidence by LD64B table lookups) and are labelled by 128-bit truncated fraction products (sections 3.1-3.3); records travel two hops in 256-record blocks and join by hash chains at hop-2 arrival (sections 2, 4); every delivery is charged as executed code under section 2.1's premises (FEAT_LS64 locations, 256-byte DC ZVA, finite receive apertures). New against kaankolcu's 2c8fcf0c: pair tables, one LD64B serving two X's (PX), u^2 and v^2 from one square (P1), a two-slot beta window (PAIRB6), limb-0 fold carries (LF3) and a canonical-cell bound on the walks' 130-bit fold (C130). Peak memory at most 2^135.9995 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^116.2876 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks every declared figure and every ledger row. Built on 2c8fcf0c and its lineage, with soispoke's flipped grid and lookups (17a007c8) and its later PX, P1 and PAIRB6 ideas (145d73c3 to 2b4a9f40), credited in proof.md section 9; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Flip kernels (fwd, bwd, keys) on production points against bit-exact models (fractions, bounds, Fourier and P1 identities, records, indices, labels), ygen's Y-records and tblx's and tbld's tables against exact references, the 3.4 sites, weak operands and fixups (sites.py), both hops and the join on a 4 x 4 machine with LS64/ISA failing tests (machine.py), every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run at least their stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
